anchor_definition: The anchor is Q, the AES encryptor in the crypto chunk: it parses the key, AES-encrypts each input field and returns { ..., encryptedParams }. For the username login the page uses encryptAes()->Q to produce the encryptedParams sent in the request. It is NOT the encryptAes accessor (which merely returns Q) nor B (the sibling RSA encryptor used by the rsa() path).

anchor.why: AES-encrypts each field of the input object with the parsed key/iv and returns {EUI, encryptedParams:u}; reached via d.encryptAes()->Q({user}) to build the username encryptedParams in the login request.

roles.why: The accessor that exposes the AES encryptor (encryptAes:function(){return Q}); a thin getter, not the encryptor itself.
The sibling RSA encryptor (exposed via rsa()); builds encryptedParams by RSA, not the AES path used for the username. A same-module decoy.
